stories.story_fr: Nous avons atteint un bénéfice par action ajusté de 2,26 $ grâce à une performance robuste du segment Vocational.
stories.story_en: We achieved adjusted earnings per share of $2.26 due to robust performance in our Vocational segment.
stories.quote: We achieved adjusted earnings per share of $2.26 due to robust performance in our Vocational segment.

stories.story_fr: Le revenu d'exploitation a baissé de 7,9 % au quatrième trimestre 2025 à cause d'un mix produit défavorable et de coûts de fabrication plus élevés.
stories.story_en: Operating income decreased 7.9% in Q4 2025 because of unfavorable product mix and higher manufacturing overhead costs.
stories.quote: The decrease in operating income was primarily due to unfavorable product mix and higher manufacturing overhead costs

stories.story_fr: Le résultat d'exploitation ajusté de 274,3 $ M au troisième trimestre 2025 reflète notre discipline de coûts et notre focus sur le flux de trésorerie.
stories.story_en: Adjusted operating income of $274.3 million in Q3 2025 reflects cost discipline and focus on cash flow.
stories.quote: Our performance reflects our commitment to cost discipline and our focus on improved cash flow

stories.story_fr: Les ventes consolidées du troisième trimestre 2025 ont chuté de 1,9 % à 2,69 $ M, principalement en raison d'un volume plus faible dans le segment Access.
stories.story_en: Consolidated sales in Q3 2025 fell 1.9% to $2.69 billion, primarily due to lower Access segment volume.
stories.quote: Consolidated sales in the third quarter of 2025 decreased $52.8 million, or 1.9 percent, to $2.69 billion primarily due to lower sales volume in the Access segment
